key_point: Portal began as a student project whose whole team got hired by Valve
title: Portal started as a student project.
caption: Portal started as a student project. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #portal #valve #theorangebox

instagram.caption:
Portal started as a student project.

In 2005 a few students at DigiPen made a free game called Narbacular Drop, where you walk through two linked doors. They showed it to Valve, and Gabe Newell hired the whole team.

Two years later they released Portal. It was meant to be a small bonus game in The Orange Box, and it became the one everybody remembers.

Did you believe in the cake?
